faqs.answer: Yes. We are a ladies-only salon.
faqs.question: Is the salon ladies only?

faqs.answer: There is free visitor parking in Cluster Y. The nearest metro station is DMCC, a short walk away.
faqs.question: Is there parking nearby?

faqs.answer: We take all major cards, Apple Pay, and cash. Tabby is available for treatments of AED 500 and above. Payment is after your appointment.
faqs.question: How can I pay?

faqs.answer: Yes, if a stylist is free. Appointments are seen first, so booking ahead is the safer bet, especially on Fridays and Saturdays.
faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?

faqs.answer: You can cancel or move your appointment free of charge up to 6 hours before it starts. Inside 6 hours, or if you do not show up, there is a fee of half the service price.
faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?

faqs.answer: Please arrive on time. We hold your chair for 10 minutes. After that we may need to shorten the service or rebook you, so the next customer is not kept waiting.
faqs.question: What if I am running late?

faqs.answer: About 2.5 hours, depending on your hair length and how light you want to go. Your stylist will confirm the timing when you book.
faqs.question: How long does balayage take?

faqs.answer: Yes, a 15 minute consultation is free. It is a good idea before a big color change, so the stylist can look at your hair and give you an exact price.
faqs.question: Do you offer a free consultation?

faqs.answer: No, all services are in the salon. That way we can use the right products and equipment for your hair and skin.
faqs.question: Do you offer home service?

faqs.answer: Yes, in the salon and over the phone. They can be used for any service and are valid for one year.
faqs.question: Do you sell gift cards?

hours.notes: Open every day. Friday hours are shorter. Public holiday hours may differ; ask us.

policies.walk_ins: Walk-ins are welcome when a stylist is free. Booked appointments are seen first.
